About Me

I started coding at 11, when my mom brought a computer home. The first thing I did was take it completely apart, and she was not happy about it. I've been coding ever since, from high school to university.

Over the years I've worked on a bit of everything: software development, embedded programming, circuit design, telecommunications, networking, AI and machine learning, deployment and DevOps, and project management.

Today I'm doing a Master of Engineering in Electrical & Computer Engineering at Concordia University, focused on AI research, while working in defense at CAE.
